title: Parabolic Bogomolov--Gieseker Inequality and Pluriharmonic Metrics on Regular Parabolic Higgs Sheaves over Compact Kähler Manifolds
summary: We prove a parabolic Bogomolov--Gieseker inequality for stable regular parabolic Higgs sheaves on a compact Kähler manifold \((X,ω)\) equipped with a simple normal crossing divisor \(D\). We also prove that a polystable regular parabolic Higgs sheaf admits a pluriharmonic metric on \(X\setminus D\), provided that each stable summand has parabolic degree zero and vanishing integrated second parabolic Chern character.
